name: Okite no Mura
source:
Main character lives in a small village and goes for sports. He can't marry his love interest girl till he passes the adulthood ritual that starts soon. If he is in top 10 winners, he can finally marry his childhood friend. Otherwise, she becomes other man's bride.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角住在一个小村庄里，喜欢运动。在他通过即将开始的成年仪式之前，他不能娶他所爱的女孩。如果他进入前十名，他终于可以和他的青梅竹马结婚了。否则，她就成了别人的新娘。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
